description: Erection of a single storey front infill extension and installation of replacement rear window and door to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (20008-3-111 (Rev P4)  Received:  04 September 2020;  20008-3-112 (Rev P2); 20008-3-110 (Rev P2)  Received:  22 July 2020;  20008-3-001 (Rev P1)  Received:  26 June 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey front extension hereby approved.
